items.title: People talking about you is good
items.summary:
People talking about you is good. ⭐️ 

It means you’re relevant. 

People gossiping about you is good fodder. 📰 It means you’re seen. Which is good if you’re a business owner on a mission with a message.

People speculating about you is good. It means your life and presence is getting people’s attention. 

🥁 🎺 I’m going to say this very clearly okay….

🗣️ IF YOU WANT TO MAKE A MASSIVE IMPACT on the lives of many many people, you have to get comfortable with people talking (and lying and gossiping) about you.

If you want to lead a life that is bigger than JUST YOU, then you need to know this is part of your job description. 

If you want to massively make a difference in the lives of other people, this is the cost. 

Logically….get your head around this. 

Too many of ya’ll watching me feel the call to start being seen. 

I see you. 
I talk to you. 
I respond to you in the DMs. 

You feel the call to make a positive difference in the lives of others. 

You feel the call because it’s meant to happen. 

You wouldn’t desire this if it wasn’t your timeline. 

But in order to live the most fulfilling, meaningful life of visibility, impact, service and success 

⚡️Getting hate, getting criticized is part of our job.

And if you want to live a life…..that MOVES moves MOVES people 👉you will naturally repel people as a result. 

People that make other people *feeeeeel* something (like really feel….) will automatically attract and repel. 

That energy, that feeling, that rawness, that honesty and aliveness does something to people. 

It stirs them. ⚡️⚡️⚡️

In either a positive way or a negative way. 
It’s not good or bad. It just is. 

This is the single indicator of a strong presence ⭐️ 

Lean in. Lean into your unique magic and play a bigger game with it. 

You deserve to be seen. You deserve to be witnessed and acknowledged. It is VALID for you to want to be seen. 

It is valid and beautiful for you to want recognition. 

Share your gifts. 

We need to see you. We need to hear you. 

You are safe. 💕
It is safe to be watched. 
It is safe to be studied. 
It is safe to be talked about. 

Follow 👉

items.title: Introduction to Jyotish Astrology with Alan Annand
items.summary:
This webinar provides an overview of Jyotish, a traditional form of astrology that’s been in continuous practice for over a millennium. Although its core philosophies, principles and techniques originated in India, it has successfully integrated select elements from Greek, Persian and other influences.

This webinar identifies Jyotish’s primary features—its use of the sidereal zodiac, whole sign houses, traditional rulerships in the absence of the outer planets, special aspects, the importance of the moon’s nodes, and a greatly-expanded range of meanings associated with each of the 12 houses.

One unique feature of Jyotish is that of yogas—a series of planetary patterns that function as signatures of enterprise, good fortune, intellectual brilliance, power, status, talent, wealth, etc. A full catalog of yogas runs to 300, although practicing jyotishis typically work with 60 or less.

Another key feature is the time-lord system of dashas, whereby each of nine celestial bodies (two luminaries, five planets, two nodes) assume control to dispense the promise implied by their dignity and placement in the chart. Although dasha periods range from 6-20 years, sub-periods called bhuktis provide greater specificity down to the level of four months.

Jyotish makes great use of divisional charts, of which there are 20, allowing analysis and prediction regarding career, education, family, health, spirituality, wealth, etc.

Like western astrology, Jyotish has its branches—jataka (natal), prashna (horary), muhurta (electional), varshaphala (annual returns) as well as multiple other applications, most notably horoscope matching for compatibility analysis.

The first class with Alan begins October 24. Keep an eye on our website for updates: https://store.keplercollege.org/current-course-offerings/

items.title: July Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A deep dive into the astrology forecast for July 2026, with astrologers Chris Brennan and Austin Coppock. 

The month opens on highly unstable ground, dominated by a volatile Mars-Uranus conjunction that threatens sudden, unpredictable shifts and explosive turns. This erratic energy is ruled by a newly stationary retrograde Mercury, which has just backed away from a conjunction with Jupiter. This combination sets the stage for logistical snafus, technological difficulties, and widespread delays right out of the gate.

Jupiter, having just entered Leo at the end of June, begins to form a tense opposition with Pluto that goes exact around the middle of the month. This highlights major power struggles and the tension between truth and control. This opposition is part of a much larger, momentous pattern of simultaneous outer planet alignments peaking this month. As Uranus completes its first exact trine with Pluto, these planets lock into a complex basket configuration alongside Jupiter and Neptune. This heavy planetary geometry indicates that significant precursor events are unfolding in the background, particularly surrounding rapid technological or military innovations.

We finally see a more positive shift in the astrological weather during the second half of the month. Mars applies to a stabilizing, constructive sextile with Saturn, helping to ground the earlier chaos. Mercury stations direct, clearing up miscommunications, and the Sun makes its triumphant ingress into Leo to form an auspicious conjunction with Jupiter. This cazimi brings a much needed wave of radiant, showy warmth and outward confidence, despite an opposition with Pluto. However, a lingering Venus-Mars square operating in the background introduces an unwelcome element of creative friction and tension in partnerships, pitting the forces of unification against the drive to sever and divide.

This late July window ultimately serves as a temporary lull, and a calm before the storm. By early August, we swiftly transition into eclipse season, bringing weighty major endings and beginnings to the forefront, just as Venus enters the shadow sign of its upcoming retrograde phase.

This is episode 541 of The Astrology Podcast.
